title: Tool descriptions are generic instead of dynamic on session resume
body:
Dynamic tool descriptions (e.g., "Reading file X") are lost and replaced by static/generic ones (e.g., "Reads and returns content...") when resuming a session using `gemini --resume`.

This occurs because:
1. `ChatRecordingService` was overwriting dynamic descriptions with static ones from the `ToolRegistry`.
2. `GeminiChat` was not passing dynamic descriptions to the recording service.

This issue has been present since the initial implementation of session recording in September 2025 (PR #6721).

Fixing in PR #18835.

triage_metadata.reasoning: No source files were pruned; all PR modifications directly address the reported issue.

summary.problem: Dynamic tool descriptions (e.g., "Reading file X") are lost and replaced by static/generic ones (e.g., "Reads and returns content...") when resuming a session using `gemini --resume`.
summary.root_cause: `ChatRecordingService.recordToolCalls` was unconditionally overwriting the recorded tool call description with generic descriptions from the `ToolRegistry`. Concurrently, `GeminiChat` (specifically within the recordCompletedToolCalls logic cluster) did not extract or pass the dynamic description from the tool invocation record.
summary.context: This issue arose from the session recording implementation introduced in PR #6721, where resumed sessions would reinitialize tool descriptions from `ToolRegistry` defaults instead of using the runtime dynamic descriptions.

steps: In `packages/core/src/core/geminiChat.ts`, update the recording mapping inside `GeminiChat` to set `description` by checking if `'invocation' in call` is true, and extracting `call.invocation?.getDescription()`, falling back to `undefined` if not present.

In `packages/core/src/services/chatRecordingService.ts`, modify `ChatRecordingService.recordToolCalls` to prioritize and preserve `toolCall.description` if provided (e.g., via `toolCall.description?.trim()`) instead of unconditionally overwriting it with `toolInstance?.description`.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Dynamic tool descriptions are preserved when recording tool calls, ensuring they do not get overwritten by generic descriptions in the registry.
verification_steps: Add a unit test checking that `ChatRecordingService.recordToolCalls` preserves a dynamic description when specified on a `ToolCallRecord`.
Verify that checking the conversation record state retrieves the correct custom description after mapping and writing to the session file.
